about: Glass's look change on the dev app: a skin change into Glass plays the launch cover's veil, then Glass's own rise. Its rise moves Glass's cards with a transform; before 2026-11-02 that slipped the window-pinned frost and drew a dark band under each title, and now each moving card holds its frost in place (paint-pin.ts, GRAND-OPENING.md §12). The skin and theme are set for the shot and put back.
pass: Each probe's expect holds. In the strip: the cards come in under the lifting cover with no dark band under any title, and nothing jumps at the end.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/glass-rise.json   (needs `npm run dev:app` running, its window on screen)

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ skin: document.documentElement.dataset.skin, boot: document.documentElement.dataset.boot ?? null })
steps.name: landed
